page.layout: One title page: title block centred at top, woodcut engraving in the middle, printer's imprint and date below. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: The engraving between the title block and the imprint is a woodcut in an oval border showing a figure at a rock with a tree, probably an emblem. Its border motto is only partly legible ("EST VIA" and "INVIA" are visible, the rest is not) and is not transcribed. The first line is cut off at the left edge of the scan. Ligatures "æ" in "præelecti" and "PHILOSOPHIÆ" are read as æ; "Dantis-" and "KECKER-" / "MANNO" are hyphenated line ends as printed.
